page.content:
1995–2001 series with Janeway stranded in the Delta Quadrant.

How Star Trek: Voyager connects

  • Character: Kathryn Janeway — Voyager is Janeway's long way home.
  • Topic: Star Trek — Voyager is the Delta Quadrant weekly series.

What is Star Trek: Voyager?

Voyager follows Captain Janeway and a mixed Starfleet/Maquis crew trying to get home from the Delta Quadrant, later with Seven of Nine.

Key threads lead to Kathryn Janeway and Star Trek.
